name: Strength of Materials
short: How materials deform and fail under load — the bridge between theory and safe design.
importantTopics: Shear force and bending moment diagrams
previousYearQuestions: Derive the relation between three elastic constants E, G and K.
Draw SFD and BMD for a simply supported beam with a UDL and a point load.
studyGuide: Master the stress–strain curve and the elastic constants first — every later chapter (beams, torsion, columns) reuses the same conceptual machinery.
